rationale: Arya is building agent-first tools with mobile-first control interfaces, while Jwalin is focused on privacy-preserving local-first AI on consumer hardware—both are solving for practical AI systems that put users in control, just at different layers. Arya's work on agentic search and mobile agent control complements Jwalin's expertise in local-first architectures and ml-infra, and they share conviction that the future is smaller, more focused AI systems rather than scaling alone.
intro_message: Arya, meet Jwalin—you're both in San Francisco building consumer-first AI systems that prioritize control and practicality, and your work on agentic mobile interfaces could be a natural fit with their local-first privacy-preserving architectures.
